cards.audioText: Please introduce the aircraft brake system?
cards.referenceText: I fly C172. Each main landing gear has disc brakes and it’s powered by hydraulic power. It’s controlled by the rudder pedal.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我驾驶 C172。该机每个主起落架均配备盘式刹车，由液压驱动，通过方向舵踏板控制。

cards.audioText: What can you do if you lose your brake system?
cards.audioTextZh: 若刹车系统失效，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: If I find this problem before takeoff, I will report to the mechanics and ask them to fix it. If the brake system is inoperative before landing, I will report to ATC and request the longest runway for landing. After touchdown, I will use maximum thrust reverser and spoilers to stop the aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh: 若起飞前发现问题，会向机械师报告并要求维修；若着陆前刹车系统失效，会向空管报告并申请最长跑道着陆；接地后，使用最大反推和减速板使飞机停稳。

cards.audioText: Will you takeoff or land on a runway when the braking action is poor?
cards.audioTextZh: 刹车效果不佳时，是否会在该跑道起飞或着陆？
cards.referenceText: I will check whether the runway is long enough for takeoff or landing. If not, I will delay takeoff or land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 会检查跑道长度是否满足起飞或着陆需求；若不满足，将延迟起飞或着陆。
